_설명: 예시 질문(빠른 질문) 설정. label 의 {month}·{org} 는 DB 의 최신 월·실제 조직 이름으로 채운다. sql 은 고정 SQL(AI 없이 답할 때도 이 SQL 을 쓴다). {org_filter} 는 조직이 해석된 때만 값 바인딩으로 채운다.

quick_questions.label: {month}월 조직별 영업이익
quick_questions.sql: SELECT org_name, revenue_won, cost_won, op_won FROM v_op WHERE version = :version AND year = :base_year AND month = :base_month AND scenario = :scn{org_filter} ORDER BY op_won DESC

quick_questions.label: {month}월 비용 상위 항목
quick_questions.sql: SELECT cat1, cat2, item, SUM(amount_won) AS amount_won FROM fact WHERE version = :version AND kind = '영업비용' AND year = :base_year AND month = :base_month AND scenario = :scn{org_filter} GROUP BY cat1, cat2, item ORDER BY amount_won DESC LIMIT 20

quick_questions.label: Gap 목록
quick_questions.sql: SELECT gap_id, org_name, item, month, scenario, basis, previous_won, current_won, diff_won, explanation_status FROM gap WHERE version = :version{org_filter} ORDER BY ABS(diff_won) DESC LIMIT 200

quick_questions.label: {org} 소명 현황
quick_questions.sql: SELECT explanation_id, org_name, item, month, scenario, link_type, status, verdict, rounds, answer, src FROM explanation WHERE version = :version{org_filter} ORDER BY org_code, month

quick_questions.label: 월별 추이
quick_questions.sql: SELECT month, scenario, SUM(revenue_won) AS revenue_won, SUM(cost_won) AS cost_won, SUM(op_won) AS op_won FROM v_op WHERE version = :version AND year = :base_year AND scenario IN ('ACTUAL', 'ESTIMATE'){org_filter} GROUP BY month, scenario ORDER BY month, scenario
